continuity.notes: The visual arc begins with contemplation of Bhagwan's form, then opens into the emotional experience and accessibility of Bhakti. Keep one consistent Guruvayurappan identity throughout.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the reference only for crown, tilak, compassionate facial expression, earrings, necklaces, flowers, and devotional presence. Replace its photorealistic portrait treatment and flute with the series temple-mural language; do not copy its framing.

scene_brief.mode: iconographic devotional portrait within a temple sanctum
must_show: A full-figure Guruvayurappan-inspired Krishna standing frontally beneath an ornate Kerala temple arch
A radiant but proportionate crown with a visible peacock feather, upright sandal-paste tilak, merciful almond-shaped eyes, gentle smile, and shapely nose
Paired makara-shaped earrings reflected softly on the cheeks
Kaustubha jewel at the neck, layered pearl and gold necklaces, Vanamala flower garland, and a clear Srivatsa mark on the chest
Deep blue skin, yellow dhoti, red-orange shawl, warm oil lamps, and restrained gold radiance
scene_brief.composition: Wide 16:9 sanctum composition with the complete figure centered slightly right, a balanced lamp and carved pillar rhythm on both sides, generous safe margins around crown, hands, and feet, and a softly receding maroon-gold temple interior.

stanzas.alt: The radiant crowned form of Guruvayurappan

landscape.composition_role: desktop, web, presentation, or book spread
landscape.composition_override: Use a wide sanctum setting around the full standing figure; preserve all iconographic details without turning the image into a close crop.

portrait.composition_role: mobile, downloadable page, cover, or portrait book page
portrait.composition_override: Recompose vertically around the complete standing figure and temple arch; do not crop or mechanically extend the landscape image.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the source only to identify the four emblems and regal ornaments. Render them in the established temple-mural style, with anatomically correct arms and no copied background.

must_show: A serene four-armed Guruvayurappan form with conch, discus, mace, and lotus clearly separated
Jeweled keyura shoulder ornaments, angada armlets, kankana bracelets, and restrained gem-set rings
Golden waistband over luminous yellow silk and fully visible lotus feet
A single devotee taking refuge at the feet, with sorrow dissolving into soft light
scene_brief.composition: Frontal full figure in a luminous sanctum, sacred emblems forming a balanced silhouette and the devotee small enough to preserve divine scale.
avoid: incorrect number of arms or fingers

stanzas.alt: The four-armed Lord as refuge from sorrow

landscape.composition_role: desktop, web, presentation, or book spread
landscape.composition_override: Balance the four emblems across the wide frame while keeping the full figure and lotus feet visible.

portrait.composition_role: mobile, downloadable page, cover, or portrait book page
portrait.composition_override: Stack the emblem-bearing arms gracefully within a vertical silhouette; create a new composition rather than cropping.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the source only as a cue for cosmic scale. Remove the flute, extra arms, animals, literal planets, and fantasy collage treatment.

must_show: The consistent Guruvayurappan form radiating from the center of three subtly layered realms
Celestial, earthly, and inner spiritual realms suggested through mural bands rather than literal astronomy
Lotus and golden aura motifs expressing beauty beyond every beautiful thing
Small awestruck devotees whose attention converges naturally on the Lord
scene_brief.composition: A broad tripartite mural field with the Lord as the single unmistakable focus and diminishing ornament toward the edges.

stanzas.alt: The Lord whose beauty surpasses the three worlds

landscape.composition_role: desktop, web, presentation, or book spread
landscape.composition_override: Let the three symbolic realms unfold laterally around the complete central figure.

portrait.composition_role: mobile, downloadable page, cover, or portrait book page
portrait.composition_override: Layer the three symbolic realms vertically around the Lord without cropping the figure.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the reference only for the dignified relationship between Narayana and Lakshmi. Replace the underwater fantasy setting with a sacred temple-celestial setting and remove any watermark.

must_show: Guruvayurappan and Goddess Lakshmi seated together on a lotus throne
Lakshmi gazing toward the Lord with unwavering loving attention
The Lord's serene beauty expressed through warm radiance, crown, Kaustubha, Vanamala, and yellow silk
A subtle stream of prosperity flowing outward toward distant devotees while Lakshmi remains beside the Lord
scene_brief.composition: Dignified divine couple centered in a celestial sanctum, with emotional focus on Lakshmi's steadfast gaze rather than romance.

stanzas.alt: Lakshmi captivated by the Lord's beauty

landscape.composition_role: desktop, web, presentation, or book spread
landscape.composition_override: Use lateral space for the outward flow of blessings and distant devotees.

portrait.composition_role: mobile, downloadable page, cover, or portrait book page
portrait.composition_override: Recompose the lotus throne and pair vertically with both complete figures visible.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the reference as a cue for Lakshmi, devotees, and a celestial gathering only. Simplify the crowd and translate the scene into the temple-mural palette.

must_show: Devotees seated in a harmonious circle singing and meditating on Guruvayurappan
Goddess Lakshmi dwelling among them and listening attentively to praises of the Lord
The Lord present as a radiant sanctum murti or subtle central vision
Cymbals, mridangam, lamps, and flower offerings used sparingly without readable lyrics
scene_brief.composition: A warm communal scene with Lakshmi among devotees in the foreground and the Lord as the shared focal point.

stanzas.alt: Lakshmi dwelling among devotees who sing the Lord's glory

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the source for the emotional idea of ecstatic devotion, not for literal pose or photographic treatment.

must_show: A small group hearing the Lord's sacred stories in a temple mandapa
A luminous vision of Guruvayurappan arising from the storyteller's devotional narration
Subtle tears, folded hands, and gentle horripilation conveying inward bliss without exaggeration
Cool pearl-like droplets and warm nectar-gold light meeting around the devotees
scene_brief.composition: Storyteller and devotees form a quiet foreground arc; the divine vision opens above and beyond them.
scene_brief.tone: tender ecstasy, inward joy, sacred stillness

stanzas.alt: Devotees overwhelmed by bliss while hearing the Lord's stories

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use only the devotional theme from the source. Build a clear symbolic path composition in the series mural language.

must_show: A direct flower-strewn path of loving devotion leading ordinary people toward Guruvayurappan
Two longer side paths symbolizing disciplined action and abstract knowledge through gestures and objects, without labels
The Lord's beauty naturally drawing every gaze and softening hearts
People of varied ages able to enter the path of Bhakti
scene_brief.composition: Three paths converge visually, with the luminous devotional path simplest and most inviting.

stanzas.alt: The effortless path of loving devotion

landscape.composition_role: desktop, web, presentation, or book spread

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the reference only for conceptual cues. Avoid diagrammatic labels and communicate the contrast entirely through devotional symbolism.

A contemplative seeker facing a subtle, abstract field of light and sacred geometry
A devotee moving naturally through a fragrant lotus-and-flower path toward Guruvayurappan
The Bhakti path glowing with sweetness while the other paths remain honorable but demanding
scene_brief.composition: Three parallel narrative zones unified by the Lord's radiance, with no textual labels.

stanzas.alt: Bhakti as the sweetest path beyond difficult karma and knowledge

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the source as an idea reference only; create a restrained mural allegory centered on effort, reason, and the softened heart.

must_show: One seeker completing demanding ritual duties until the mind becomes clear like polished brass

A humble devotee whose heart visibly softens like a lotus opening before Guruvayurappan
The Lord present as the compassionate destination of all sincere seeking
scene_brief.composition: Three figures progress across a restrained symbolic landscape, with the opening-heart devotee closest to the Lord.

stanzas.alt: The long paths of discipline and reasoning beside melting devotion

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use the source only for the devotional culmination. Depict the nectar of sacred stories symbolically, without books or scrolls containing readable writing.

Guruvayurappan standing at the source with fully visible lotus feet

Soft narrative silhouettes within the flowing light, with no readable words
